claim_en: MIRIAM SPOKE FIRST; THE CUSHITE WOMAN IS THE BEAUTIFUL WOMAN, DISTANCED; THE A-FORTIORI OF SLANDER. 'And Miriam spoke, and Aaron' — the FEMININE SINGULAR verb before two subjects (Vpw3fs — computed): Miriam first, not her practice (Baruch before Jeremiah); 'dibbur' is harsh speech, 'amirah' imploration — a lexical rule with proof-seats (Gen 42:30; Num 21:5 / Gen 19:7; Num 12:6); how she knew — Zipporah unadorned; THE A-FORTIORI (I1): Miriam meant praise, increase and privacy and was punished — how much more one who defames, diminishes, in public (the exam's Arakhin 15a-16b; Deut 24:9); 'the Cushite woman' with the article, 'a Cushite woman' without (one seat each) — CUSHITE = EXCEPTIONAL as a Cushite in his skin (Saul, Israel, Baruch — a lexical rule): beautiful in appearance AND in deed; Onkelos renders both 'the BEAUTIFUL woman' and inserts 'he had DISTANCED' (cut from the shelf's bytes) — the spine agrees with itself twice on this verse.
middah: I1 (the Sifrei's a-fortiori from Miriam's punishment to the defamer; the grammar and the translation's moves computed and cut)

claim_en: HE TOLD THEM THEIR OFFENSE, THEN DEPARTED; THE CLOUD LEFT FIRST; LEPROUS AS SNOW; AARON TURNED FROM HIS OWN; A PRIEST DOES NOT INSPECT HIS KIN; THE COVERED THREE. Yehudah b. Beteira: who says Aaron was stricken, ZELOPHEHAD WAS THE WOOD-GATHERER, or Akavya was banned 'will pay' — against R. Akiva at 113:1: the shelf disagrees with itself on the record, the tent's num_15 unit carrying the dispute unresolved (NM15-01); 'as one dead' (Ps 31:13 the other seat) — the leper defiles by entry as the corpse by tent (I3); 'our sister loses on all accounts: I cannot quarantine, declare unclean or clean' — A PRIEST DOES NOT INSPECT HIS KIN (the exam's Zevachim 101b-102a); 'his mother', 'his flesh' — the euphemisms for 'our', RESOLVED by Onkelos ('for she is our sister; pray for this dead flesh in her, and let it be healed' — 12:12 rewritten, cut from the shelf's bytes).
